title: Workspace redesign: what shipped and what remains
description:
Status 2026-10-19 for epic chatticus-daa715.

## Shipped to develop (production as of 2026-10-18)
- Flat workspace with a panel plugin host and per-reply usage (first slice).
- Full-height workspace on iPad Safari, resizable sidebar and panel.
- Panel plugins load from manifests as custom elements (Context, Files, Costs run on that path).
- Reply latency shown beside cost on replies and the conversation chip.
- A screenshot gallery (desktop, iPad, phone) is posted on every web pull request.

## Remaining
- Kanbus board plugin (workspace files now, cloud DynamoDB-backed board later).
- Monaco code editor plugin (full screen, file tree, terminal, embedded coding assistant).
- Browser tab plugin.
- AWS spend against the 50 USD monthly ceiling shown in the workspace (see chatticus-9ac621 for the unresolved hosted-organization meter).
- Dark mode polish; plugin standard decision (Korporus web components).

Design notes: /ui-design/panel-plugin-contract.md and competitor-review-kylon.md in the project files. Brand rule: flat regions, no borders or outlines. Ryan reviews from an iPad, so UI pull requests need the screenshot gallery.
